# Source control
Source: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/source-control/
Markdown: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/source-control/index.md
Description: Connect GitHub to GGX so projects can clone, sync, and push code repositories.

Source control integrations let a project keep its code in Code Repos that are cloned from, synced with, and pushed to your repository host.

| Integration | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [GitHub](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/source-control/github/) | Clone, sync, and push repositories, and serve GitHub Issues. |
